candidate_pool.source: existing active situation lesson exercises + quiz items
candidate_pool.role_filter: match guest.profile.role when present; otherwise use all active situations

slot_order.selection: Earliest due review_item whose stable source item exists in active content and matches the current role.
Item whose primary_skill or skills matches assessment_weak_skills[0].
Item matching the next distinct weak skill (assessment first, then existing mistake/performance evidence).
Pick an item from one of the existing 3–5 Recommended for you situations, preferring incomplete/low-mastery content.
Role-compatible item from an underexposed/incomplete situation; venue_type is a tie-breaker and english_level may rank difficulty but never block.

dedupe_rules: No duplicate stable item_id in one session.
Prefer no duplicate situation_slug; allow only if needed to reach 5.
Prefer at most 2 items of the same exercise type when enough alternatives exist.
stability_rules: Once created, today's session item list never changes.
Session key is guest_id + browser local_date + role.
Changing interface language changes rendered localization only, not the selected item IDs.
If role changes, a different session may exist for that same date under the new role.
algorithm.deterministic_tiebreak: Stable hash of guest_id + local_date + item_id; never use runtime AI or non-deterministic random selection after session creation.
algorithm.country_variants: Do not implement in this phase.
algorithm.saved_emergency_phrases: Do not inject into the scored 5-item session in this phase.

scoring.focus_skill: Among incorrect answers, choose the skill with the highest error count; ties use slot order. If all correct, use the guest's first current weak skill if available, otherwise omit focus.
scoring.srs_policy: READ due review_items for selection, but do not modify generic SRS/review_items in MVP v1.

api_contract.start: POST /api/guests/{guest_id}/tonights-shift/start with local_date from browser; create or return today's in-progress/completed session for current role.
api_contract.content_rendering: Return the selected existing items using the same localized payload/grading conventions already used by lessons. Do not expose a second content format unless required.

ux_contract: Card shows title, 3–5 minutes, and 5 quick questions.
One item per screen using existing exercise components where possible.
Use existing immediate feedback pattern where possible.
Completion screen shows X/5 and optional focus skill.
If already completed today, Home can show completion state rather than starting a new session.
No streak, XP, coins, leaderboard, paywall or AI.
regression_contract: Can I Work in English assessment remains intact.
Home → Learn → Lesson → Practice remains intact.
